recommended_claim: The study evaluates a UAV-oriented elephant trajectory-forecasting and uncertainty-aware virtual-geofence warning framework using frozen internal and external evaluations.
prohibited_claim: The full detector-to-warning system has been validated end-to-end in field conditions.

recommended_claim: The elephant detector provides the historical detection foundation, while later end-to-end stress testing shows substantial domain-transfer limitations on BIRDSAI TestReal.
prohibited_claim: The detector is universally robust across UAV datasets and domains.

recommended_claim: Historical forecasting experiments use annotated/ground-truth trajectory observations rather than fully detector-generated tracks.
prohibited_claim: All reported forecasting results are produced end-to-end from detector outputs.

recommended_claim: Camera-motion correction improves reference-frame geometric consistency and supports a raw-versus-corrected forecasting/warning ablation.
prohibited_claim: Camera-corrected trajectories are world-coordinate ground truth.

recommended_claim: Isotropic scaling removes aspect-ratio distortion in Euclidean geometry but does not universally improve forecasting performance.
prohibited_claim: Isotropic normalization is uniformly superior for all models and horizons.

recommended_claim: The frozen three-seed Transformer ensemble provides small, statistically consistent benefits over individual-seed comparators on supported datasets/horizons.
prohibited_claim: Transformer is the best model overall or is novel by itself.

recommended_claim: Frozen conformal thresholds provide uncertainty sets with dataset- and horizon-dependent empirical coverage.
prohibited_claim: Ensemble spread is a calibrated probability or BAMBI 5 s q90 is well calibrated.

recommended_claim: The virtual-geofence experiments quantify warning behavior under a normalized synthetic boundary protocol.
prohibited_claim: The geofence represents a surveyed real village/farm boundary or proves field effectiveness.

recommended_claim: Prediction horizons of 2 s and 5 s are forecasting horizons; measured compute latency is only one component of total operational response latency.
prohibited_claim: A 2 s or 5 s prediction horizon proves a human or drone can respond within that time.

recommended_claim: Frozen end-to-end stress testing exposes severe detector/tracker coverage limitations, with detector domain transfer as the dominant observed bottleneck.
prohibited_claim: Tracking performance is strong enough to support representative downstream forecasting.

recommended_claim: Report 45 TestReal original dataset-level tracks, 37 represented original tracks and 89 forecastable segments for 2 s, and 31 represented original tracks and 63 forecastable segments for 5 s.
prohibited_claim: Call 89 or 63 the number of original dataset tracks.

recommended_claim: BAMBI Flight 6 is a red-deer/human cross-species, cross-domain transfer stress test.
prohibited_claim: BAMBI Flight 6 is elephant-specific validation or a pristine untouched confirmatory holdout.

recommended_claim: The current four-class detector reduces false-elephant alarms in external no-elephant mixed-animal scenes but incurs a large loss in elephant sensitivity/recall/F1.
prohibited_claim: The current four-class detector is a robust replacement for the elephant-only detector.

recommended_claim: WildBox evaluation remains in normalized/image coordinates because no verified source-specific metric-scale anchor was available.
prohibited_claim: Report WildBox ADE/FDE or camera translations directly in meters.

recommended_claim: Fresh WildBox, BIRDSAI TestReal and BAMBI provide complementary external or transfer evaluations with different limitations.
prohibited_claim: Treat all external datasets as equivalent pristine confirmatory tests.
